tips.text: Buy every beacon Baro stocks and burn one per mission in a recruit-chat squad instead of grinding Death Marks.
Run Corpus Invasion missions with other marked players; every marked squadmate raises the spawn chance.
Pick Survival, where you stay in anyway; Capture works if you finish the objective and wait out the 5 minutes.
Restart the mission if the Hunter has not appeared by 5:00; the window does not reopen.
Stun-lock the Hunter with Trinity's Energy Vampire or Ivara's Sleep Arrows; hard crowd control like Mag Pull does nothing.
Chain knockdowns with Nekros Soul Punch or a big melee slam while you shoot.
Expect a coin flip: about three hours for one player, weeks for another.
Players rank the Detron and Brakk as the two most annoying mastery weapons to finish.
